identification: Several used Australian stamp albums: Kangaroo (1/2d, 1d, 3d, 6d, 9d, 1/-, 2/- maroon, some perfins/heavy cancels), KGV heads, QEII definitives, 1950s-60s commemoratives, fauna/flora, Christmas issues, plus modern FDCs and blocks in an open album. Used, common material; photos show no key rarities (no 5/- or higher Kangaroo, no inverted watermark seen).
